observation_source: Human photograph of the panic screen
panic: NATIVE_UFS auto stream: no reusable exact stream among 128 slots @NativeUfs.cpp:424
result: With the Linux-validated SMMU model (IDR0/1/2 at 0x20/0x24/0x28) and a scan of all 128 stream slots, none of the firmware streams is reusable: the SMR write to create a bypass context reads back zero and the firmware streams are not in the bypass shape the driver requires.
limits: Does not prove the SMMU is secure; consistent with it. The secure/non-secure split would need vendor documentation or a secure-world call to confirm.
